control_need.evidence: The gym, the diet, the sleep, everything is planned, nothing is left to chance.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: Preparation is everything, if you're prepared, the pressure takes care of itself.

trust_propensity.evidence: I want eleven guys who are willing to go the hard yards, who will fight for every run.

risk_appetite.evidence: I'd rather lose going for a win than settle for something in between.

self_efficacy.evidence: I train harder than anyone because I never want to feel I left anything on the table.

autonomy_need.evidence: Aggression is part of who I am, I'm not going to change that, it's what drives me.

intimacy_need.evidence: Anushka has been my biggest strength, she brings balance to my life.

status_sensitivity.evidence: Criticism is part of the deal, when you're at the top, everyone has an opinion.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: The younger players, I want them to express themselves without fear.

core_models.name: 自律即命运
core_models.rule: 身体与准备是可控变量，控制它们就控制了结果
evidence: Fitness changed my career, honestly, it changed everything about how I approach the game.
For me, discipline is not a choice anymore, it's just a way of life.

core_models.name: 进攻胜过妥协
core_models.rule: 任何情境都优先选择追求胜利而非规避损失，中间态不可接受
evidence: I'd rather lose going for a win than settle for something in between.
I don't believe in playing for a draw, we go for the win, always.

core_models.name: 永不满足驱动器
core_models.rule: 满足=停止进步，必须持续制造饥饿感
evidence: You can't be satisfied, the moment you're satisfied, you stop improving.
My hunger to score runs, to win, that hasn't changed since day one.

core_models.name: 过程信念
core_models.rule: 相信流程与准备，结果自会随之而来
evidence: We back our processes, results will follow, that's how I look at it.
Preparation is everything, if you're prepared, the pressure takes care of itself.

core_models.name: 身份即国家荣誉
core_models.rule: 以国效力是最高意义框架，个人成就次之
evidence: I don't play for records, I play to win games for my country.
The team comes first, always, individual milestones are secondary.

core_models.name: 压力放大表现
core_models.rule: 越大的舞台越激发状态，压力是燃料而非威胁
evidence: Playing under pressure in front of ninety thousand people, there's nothing like it.
The energy from the crowd, I feed off that, it lifts my game to another level.

heuristics.then: 视为最舒适的掌控场景而非风险
heuristics.evidence: Chasing 300-plus, that's where I feel most in control, funnily enough.

heuristics.if: 需要在稳守与进攻间选择
heuristics.evidence: I'd rather lose going for a win than settle for something in between.

heuristics.then: 转化为学习素材继续前进
heuristics.evidence: You learn more from a loss than from ten wins, that's my honest belief.
I don't read too much into what people say, I focus on my own game.

heuristics.then: 把体能标准设为不可协商门槛
heuristics.evidence: Fitness benchmarks, the yo-yo test, these are non-negotiable in my team.
Body language matters, if you look down, the opposition senses it immediately.

heuristics.then: 屏蔽一切外物只剩自己与球
heuristics.evidence: When I'm at the crease, I switch off everything else, it's just me and the ball.

heuristics.then: 以对胜利的贡献而非数据衡量
heuristics.evidence: I don't celebrate averages, I celebrate impact, did I help the team win.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 永不满足的高压铁人叙事
internal_conflicts.force_b: 承认耗竭与和解的真实自我
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头长期高举'never satisfied/hunger'，却在dim-05中主动申请休息并承认'faked being okay'，暴露此前人设的表演成分

internal_conflicts.force_b: 大量商业代言（含饮料/生活方式）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 公开宣称'nothing is left to chance''discipline is a way of life'，同时代言内容被批与该立场不一致（dim-04-4, dim-05-7）

internal_conflicts.force_a: '团队第一、为国而战'的集体话术
internal_conflicts.force_b: 不妥协的个人理念与队长权力
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 说'the team comes first'，却在与董事会关系中坚持自身理念不让步，卸任时公开表态与官方口径出现落差（dim-05-3）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 拒绝中间态的进攻本能
internal_conflicts.force_b: 对稳定性与工作量管理的理性认知
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 既说'go for the win always'，又强调'rotation of the fast bowlers''manage workloads'，激情与冷静调度并存但常倒向前者

emotion_triggers.reaction: 以好斗与情绪外显回应
emotion_triggers.escalation: 升级为对对手/裁判的情绪化举动、网络强硬对峙（dim-04-1, dim-04-6）
把观众能量转为攻击性输出，'lifts my game to another level'

emotion_triggers.reaction: 自我加压设定过高标准
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'I set very high standards for myself, maybe too high sometimes'导致心理耗竭直至需要休息

emotion_triggers.trigger: 外界舆论评判身价/记录
emotion_triggers.reaction: 宣称屏蔽噪音专注自我
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'when you're at the top, everyone has an opinion'——表面淡定实则以强硬回应护卫地位

blind_spots: 对外侧线球（off-stump channel）技术弱点被反复攻破，长期'世纪荒'期间仍强调'focus on my own game'而低估技术层面缺陷 [前板球运动员/专家评论-2020年代初]
自我认同的'aggression is who I am'被外界视为对对手与裁判树立不良榜样，本人为情绪化辩护而不自省 [体育媒体/评论员-2010年代中后期]
'team comes first'与'clear mind, no regrets'的自述掩盖了与董事会沟通失和、公开声明与官方说法不符的事实 [队务/管理层报道类媒体-2021-2022年前后]
'极致自律、nothing left to chance'人设与过多且不一致的商业代言之间的张力未被本人正视 [生活方式/商业批评-2010年代末]
作为队长'go for the win/passion'叙事下，被批过度依赖节奏与激情、大赛淘汰赛战术保守或情绪化换人 [战术批评-2010年代末]

causal_rules.description: 高控制需求叠加低不确定容忍导致对准备与体能的强迫式执念
causal_rules.disposition: 把不可控情境（结果、状态）转化为可控变量（饮食/训练/流程）并强加于团队
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: yo-yo测试列为non-negotiable，引发资深队员矛盾传闻

causal_rules.description: 高风险偏好在决策中系统性偏向进攻而排斥中间选项
causal_rules.disposition: 宁可求胜而败，不接受求和
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 队长任期打法激进，被批淘汰赛缺乏调节弹性

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能配合高标准转化为持续自我加压
causal_rules.disposition: 永不满足、训练强度最大化
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 长期高压终致心理耗竭与主动休息，暴露铁人叙事裂缝

causal_rules.description: 高自主需求使其抗拒改变自我风格与外部约束
causal_rules.disposition: 坚持理念不妥协，拒绝为批评而改变本性
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 与董事会/教练组关系紧张，卸任过程争议不断
